hook: PostgreSQL 19 is out, try it live
hookText: PostgreSQL 19 is out, try it live

beats.say: PostgreSQL 19.0 was released on 19 November 2026, bringing useful new SQL alongside maintenance and replication improvements.
Replication experiments spin up real servers on demand: a logical subscriber on port 5433 and a physical standby on 5434, fed by the primary on 5432.
The tour runs everything in the browser, including a manual vacuum comparison between parallel zero and parallel two.
